customManagers.description: Digest-pinned oven/bun references inside .gitlab-ci.yml script blocks. The gitlabci manager only reads image: keys, so the admission-policy docker run line would otherwise go stale. The (?m)^\s+ anchor excludes image: lines so nothing is extracted twice.

packageRules.description: Group GitHub Actions workflow updates into one PR.
Group npm/bun production dependencies into one PR.
Group npm/bun dev dependencies into one PR.
Group Dockerfile FROM base image updates into one PR.
Group Dockerfile ARG tool version bumps from the custom regex manager.

Group every Bun runtime pin (.tool-versions, packageManager, Dockerfile FROM, .gitlab-ci.yml images and script refs) into one PR. Renovate cannot edit the Markdown prose, and it leaves a still-satisfied semver range in package.json engines.bun untouched after bumping the canonical pin elsewhere, while the checker requires an exact match rather than just a satisfied range, so both still need a hand edit; grouping makes that one PR instead of several.
Auto-merge non-major bumps across all managers once CI is green. Major bumps open a PR for review.
Strip 'v' prefix: hashicorp/terraform GitHub tags are vX.Y.Z but ARG value is unprefixed.
Strip 'kustomize/' prefix: kubernetes-sigs/kustomize is a monorepo with per-product tags.
Wait 7 days before raising minor/patch/digest PRs to catch bad releases before automerge.
Wait 14 days before raising major update PRs for manual review stability.
